changelog: **Win a lost customer back** (#2842, decision #2572 Q4). `POST /api/mentorship/[id]/win-back` (owner or ADMIN) closes an open DEAL_LOST record as COMPLETED + the new lifecycle state `ENDED_CHURNED` and opens a new journey at TRIAL_ACTIVE (fresh trial window) or DEAL_WON, linked by `previousRelationId`, in one transaction that re-asks the one-active-mentor rule (#419). Rule `src/lib/winBackRule.ts` (unit-tested), store `src/lib/winBack.ts`, `WinBackPanel` on the sales lead page; the account page labels such a chain "won back" rather than "continues an earlier deal". e2e `e2e/win-back.spec.ts`.

en: A lost customer who comes back starts a new journey with one click — a new trial or signed straight away — and the return counts as a new win.
tr: Geri dönen kayıp bir müşteri tek tıkla yeni bir yolculuğa başlar — yeni deneme ya da doğrudan imza — ve dönüş yeni bir kazanım sayılır.
de: Ein verlorener Kunde, der zurückkommt, startet mit einem Klick eine neue Customer Journey — neue Testphase oder direkt unterschrieben — und die Rückkehr zählt als neuer Gewinn.
